@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+; With --ignore-diacritics, include globs were compiled as written but
+; matched against folded file names, so café.dat could not be included,
+; while cafe.dat brought in café.dat as well.  File names now match
+; exactly, whatever the option says.
+
+include include-glob-diacritics/café.dat
+include include-glob-diacritics/cafe.dat
+
+test --ignore-diacritics bal
+              $-8.00  Assets:Cash
+               $8.00  Expenses
+               $5.00    Cafe
+               $3.00    Café
+--------------------
+                   0
+end test
+
+; The option still folds report queries.
+test --ignore-diacritics bal cafe
+               $8.00  Expenses
+               $5.00    Cafe
+               $3.00    Café
+--------------------
+               $8.00
+end test

@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+; In an include glob, every character except ?, * and a [...] set matches
+; only itself.  $ and ^ used to reach the regex unescaped, as anchors, so
+; none of these files could be included, whether the name was written out
+; or matched with ?.
+
+include include-glob-literals/a$b.dat
+include include-glob-literals/^c.dat
+include include-glob-literals/d$?.dat
+include include-glob-literals/^g?.dat
+
+test bal
+             $-15.00  Assets:Cash
+              $15.00  Expenses
+               $2.00    Caret
+               $8.00    CaretGlob
+               $1.00    Dollar
+               $4.00    DollarGlob
+--------------------
+                   0
+end test
